name: Nishikujou Ayahime
source:
Affiliation: Yayoi Academy 1st year, Group CFavorite Food: Strawberry yoghurt
Gift: Mirror Shade (can reflect anything thrown at her)

Ayame serves as Nadeshiko's bodyguard and best friend who accompanies her almost anywhere she goes. Highly trained in martial arts, she solely protects Nadeshiko from harm.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/12/hhg-megami-no-shuuen-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
